messages:
anya: Heads-up — I opened a small PR to replace the old JS heatmap snippet with a Rust + TS combo that uses the new telemetry wrapper. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4032 :eyes:

sam: Nice. Is this the one that also updates the cost/latency breakdown example to include kv-cache attribution?

anya: yes — the example shows cost tokens vs kv cache hits now. I left a short migration note in the PR description.

mike: quick skim: the Rust example looks good but the TypeScript usage is missing the `TraceKey` param. can we add that? some customers rely on it.

anya: good catch. I'll add a minimal TS snippet. wanted to keep it tiny but agree we should show TraceKey.

leo: also, there was a broken link in the dashboard docs pointing to the old heatmap query. we should update that to the new kibana-like query in the snippet. I can patch the doc if you want.

anya: please do, @leo. I flagged the docs file in the PR diff (docs/console/heatmaps.md).

sam: FYI @docs-bot triggered a link-check run and reported one redirect for `telemetry-setup.md` — might be unrelated but worth fixing in the same pass.

docs-bot: link-check: found 1 redirect (https://old.example.com/telemetry-setup -> https://docs.redwood.ai/telemetry-setup). Marked as warning on the PR.

anya: going to push a tiny TS snippet patch and a one-line note about TraceKey. After that, can we merge? target is to ship before next docs cut.

mike: if you add TraceKey and the updated dashboard query, I'm good to approve. also please add a brief note in the migration checklist about verifying cost breakdown numbers on a staging dataset.

leo: I'll push the dashboard link fix separately and reference the PR number. avoids merge conflicts.

infra-bot: deploy-preview: preview site built for PR #4032 — https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/4032 — smoke tests: partial (watching redirects).

anya: thanks infra-bot. I pushed the TS snippet now, plus a short line in migration checklist. PR updated: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4032/files

sam: LGTM from me pending CI. :thumbsup:

mike: approving once CI green. I left one nit about wording ("KV cache hits" -> "KV-cache hits (prefix-aware)").

anya: changed wording as requested and added a tiny code block showing TraceKey usage:
```
// TypeScript example
import { telemetry } from '@redwood/telemetry'
telemetry.trace({
  traceKey: 'session-1234',
  attrs: { route: '/dashboard/heatmap' }
})
```

leo: perfect. merging my link fix now and will reference PR 4032 in the commit message.

anya: thanks all. I'll wait for green CI then merge and add a short release note in the docs changelog.

sam: can someone add a quick QA checklist item: "open console heatmap for sample org -> confirm cost breakdown shows kv cache line"? saves followups.

mike: added to the PR comment with steps.

anya: awesome. closing the loop — will ping #docs when merged. :party_parrot:
